newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING - CV Therapeutics not effective.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING - CV Therapeutics not effective.

text.p: The initial public offering of CV Therapeutics Inc priced but had not gone effective Tuesday morning, lead underwriter for the deal, JP Morgan Securities, said.
Exact terms for the deal were not available Tuesday morning but the underwriter said information should be out later in the day.
The 2.5 million offering was expected to price between $8 to $9 a share, after being decreased from $12 to $14 a share on Monday.
The Palo Alto, Calif.-based pharmaceutical company, specializing in molecular cardiology, will trade on the Nasdaq Market under the symbol "CVTX."
